title: Great day in Tangier!...
text: Great day in Tangier! Mahsa provided us with everything we needed to know ahead of time. She was extremely helpful and organized which made our day run smoothly. Muhamed was an excellent and charismatic tour guide who showed us the entire city. The lunch was delicious and the camel ride on the beach was unforgettable. Thank you for an amazing experience in Morocco!!
author: Sara_R

title: Wonderful Experience
text: Wonderful experience! Fernando was our driver to and from Tarifa. He was interesting and knowledgeable. Great experience driving to and from the port. Once we arrive in Morocco, Mustafa took such good care of us! The day went by so fast and got to see many of the highlights of Tangier. The short day trip made me want to return to Morocco for a longer visit!
author: Jennifer_C

title: Wonderful trip to Tangier!
text: What a special day!  We did the day trip tour from Seville to Tangier, Morocco.  Our driver, Daniel, to and from Seville to the Tarifa port was timely, kind, and got us safely to where we needed to be for our trip across to Morocco.  His communication was also great!  The day in Tangier was wonderful!  We visited markets, Hercules cave, parks, and did a camel ride on the beach.  We had a private tour with Mostafa, and he was so friendly and excited to show us all of the parts of Tangier at a comfortable pace. title: Absurd Experience for Life

title: Everything you wanted to do in one day
text:
The trip was long but it was so enjoyable you didn't realize how late it was.  

Fernando was very courteous and got us to the ferry on a timely matter

Sharif our tour guide was amazing.  He was very knowledgeable, funny, and very kind.  We were in great hands
author: Hazel T

title: Unforgettable Crossing from Europe to Africa
text:
I had an incredible experience on my day trip from Seville to Tangier. Many thanks to Mahsa, Daniel Fernando and the rest of their team.

Daniel picked me up directly from my hotel in Seville and drove me all the way to Tarifa. Along the way, he stopped at a beautiful viewpoint where he kindly took photos for me before we continued to the ferry terminal. He was very attentive and caring. He didn't simply drop me off at the port. He accompanied me all the way to the ferry entrance and made sure I understood the boarding process.

title: Highlight of our vacation!
